SV AR EN ES FR

This is a translation of the Swedish lyrics and cannot be sung.

1.

God loves without compare And loves each one, To poor and rich He has the same love. His fatherly heart yearns For every human soul, Not the least child does He forget, But provides for its well-being.

2.

And He in grace turned To poor sinners, He sent His only Son, True God and Saviour. And now He faithfully knocks On the heart in every breast, He shall not lose any, Of those He has redeemed.

3.

His love toward us burns, It is so rich and full, It constantly overflows Only for His own sake. We cannot earn A single drop thereof, But God in Christ Jesus Freely gave it to us.

4.

No voice from earth Bade Him descend To this poor world, Where all suffered from the fall. Sent by the Father, He came Down here from heaven’s height To transform all our need Into eternal peace and joy.

Text: Teodor T. Truvé, 1889. Musik: Anonym, 1903. 7.6.7.6 D
